name: seize_the_spoils_discards_a_card_as_a_cost_draws_two_and_makes_one_treasure
notes: Printed: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card. Draw two cards and create a Treasure token.' Seat 0 holds Seize the Spoils ({2}{R}) and two spare cards, with Drawn One and Drawn Two on top of its library. It casts the spell, paying its mana and discarding Spare One as the additional cost (chosen from the other cards in hand, never the spell itself). The spell then draws exactly two cards (Drawn One, Drawn Two) and creates exactly one Treasure token under its controller (seat 0), not seat 1. Final: hand = Spare Two, Drawn One, Drawn Two (3); graveyard = Seize the Spoils + Spare One; one Treasure on the battlefield.
